prompts.age5: ONE square AAC pictogram of a single clear drinking tumbler three quarters full of opaque white milk. Entire glass centered with generous margins, viewed from slightly above the front, true transparent background outside glass, bold dark #202020 outlines, solid color regions. Milk should read as white milk with an obvious smooth elliptical liquid surface and opaque white body. No ice, foam, straw, bottle, people, scenery, text, gradients, glare or texture. Age 5: simplified chunky glass, flat pure white milk, simple medium blue accent on thick glass base, minimal lines and no shadows.
